frequency_question: What proportion of highly disruptive, high-visibility proposed fee rules proceed to a finalized rule within one year of initial surfacing?
membership_rule: Includes major federal agency rulemakings proposing significant fee hikes (>100% increases) subjected to public notice and comment; excludes minor technical amendments or fee adjustments below inflation indices.

cases.name: SEC Consolidated Audit Trail Fee Adjustments
EPA Chemical Fee Rule under TSCA
Patent and Trademark Office Fee Adjustments

provenance_note: claimed 4 hits but 5 of 5 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases; rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 representative major fee rulemakings named; population estimated at roughly 10-15 similar high-impact fee rules per presidential term.
known_gaps: Excludes rules that stalled indefinitely in internal review without reaching the Federal Register proposal stage.
skeleton: Major regulatory dockets initiated with high-level agency backing advance to final rules in roughly 4 out of 5 historical instances unless blocked by broad preliminary injunctions within the 1-year window.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to the current executive administration's regulatory pacing and rulemaking lifecycle, which remains stable until the end of the presidential term.
